newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania opposition urges West to help end crisis.
newsitem.headline: Albania opposition urges West to help end crisis.

text.p: Albania's 11-party opposition Forum for Democracy on Wednesday appealed to the United States and Europe to help Albania find a political solution to the crisis shaking the Balkan state and to avoid civil war.

The Forum for Democracy, in a written statement, called on the international community to put pressure on President Sali Berisha and his Democratic Party government to end a state of emergency and seek a negotiated solution.

"The Forum for Democracy...appeals to international public opinion, to the governments of the EU, USA, to the non-governmental organisations for their support to the Albanian people," the statement said.
"Being convinced that the crisis has a political solution, we appeal to them to do their best to avoid a civil war in Albania."
The alliance, grouped around the former communists, urged the West to press for an end to emergency rule introduced on Sunday and the start of dialogue with the opposition.

It also asked the European Union to send a delegation to Tirana and said Western financial aid should be linked to a political solution. At least 20 people have died in southern Albania since the latest outbreak of violence last week and troops were pursuing operations to quell the unrest.
